scope: Focused native Linux x64 development conformance with full Chrome for Testing. No current full-core, macOS, release or comparative performance acceptance.

contract.registration: Context/page scripts belong to their exact original renderer sessions. Existing ready renderers receive runImmediately:false; pending renderers install applicable scripts before resume. The context configuration read barrier includes readiness publication.
contract.disposal: Disposal removes IDs through original sessions, including retained retired owners. Logical retirement is distinct from confirmed native destruction. Pending commands and original renderer leases survive bounded recovery; uncertain settlement retires the original page/context.
contract.failure: Consumed malformed replies are never repolled. Native error shortcuts require this command response provenance. Confirmed session destruction wakes pending removal even when its native reply is withheld.
